args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The function's docstring and tests/test_money.py expect banker's
rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP.
This caused 2.665 to round to 2.67 instead of 2.66, failing the
nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212). This caused the nightly build to fail on `test_half_even` (e.g., `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
